description: The jwt skill: a development guide for the jwt JSON Web Token library for Go.

plugins.name: jwt
plugins.description: Development guide for the jwt JSON Web Token library for Go: signing and verifying tokens, claims and expiry, algorithm choice (HMAC/RSA/RSA-PSS/ECDSA/EdDSA), kid-based key rotation, JWKS fetch/refresh/publish, blocklisting and testing.
